steps.label: primitive puerts_class_defaults_patch is NOT usable
steps.detail: not registered and not in the tool inventory
steps.why: set class-default (CDO) properties on a generated Blueprint. The AI slice needs AIControllerClass and AutoPossessAI on the pawn; puerts_blueprint_build writes component template properties and member variable defaults, and has no section for the actor's own class defaults, so an authored pawn can never be possessed by an authored controller

steps.label: primitive puerts_scene_batch is NOT usable
steps.detail: not registered and not in the tool inventory
steps.why: place a NavMeshBoundsVolume and the guard pawn in the level; puerts_spawn_actor cannot set a volume's brush extent or label the actor

steps.label: primitive puerts_nav_build is NOT usable
steps.detail: not registered and not in the tool inventory
steps.why: rebuild navigation so MoveTo can path. The legacy catalog has ai_nav_rebuild behind the HTTP opt-in; lane K's puerts_nav_inspect and puerts_nav_query are read-only by design, so no registered tool builds a navmesh

steps.label: 7. watch the guard patrol
steps.detail: a Behavior Tree only ticks in a running game. PIE is reserved for the user to ask for, and the only runtime observation surface is the pie_agent_* family, which is legacy-only and also user-gated.
